description: We’re a Sydney team of four (Andre, Johanna, David and Shaf) who took on Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. We built Seed Data, a web app that helps Australian grain farmers choose a crop rotation for their paddock. It turns ten years of NASA POWER weather and MODIS greenness data into a short story about any paddock, then ranks rotations for the farmer’s goals. Every number has a source. Try it: https://seed-data-nasa.vercel.app
